title: The cotangent complex of a scheme over a ring is the cotangent complex of sheaves of rings

difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a ring Lambda and a scheme X over Lambda one has L_{X/Spec(Lambda)} = L_{O_X/Lambda}, the constant sheaf with value Lambda on X (source lines 4167-4176). The proof is parallel to the algebraic-space version: it considers the structure morphism p : X -> Spec(Lambda) and the obvious morphism q : Spec(Lambda) -> (*, Lambda), uses the distinguished triangle for ringed spaces to reduce to the vanishing of L_q, and checks that vanishing on stalks, where the stalk is identified with the cotangent complex of the local ring Lambda_p over Lambda, which vanishes by the localization case of the vanishing lemma.
